passages.title: Jihun’s Morning
text: The alarm clock is going off.
He looks out the window and checks the weather.
He puts his books and lunchbox in his backpack and grabs his umbrella.
As he leaves, he says, “Ugh! My backpack is so heavy!”
koreanText: 그는 책과 도시락을 책가방에 넣고 우산을 집어 들어요.
그는 출발하면서 “윽! 책가방이 정말 무거워!”라고 말해요.
